All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class MainView extends javafx.scene.layout.StackPane
Main View Controller using a Tab-based layout. Tabs: 1. Setup (Scenario & World Config) 2. Simulation (Map & Controls)
